test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 1 June 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.**

The lawyer had presented the facts of the case well.

options.text: The facts of the case had presented the lawyer well.
The facts of the case had been presented well by the lawyer.
The facts of the case were being presented by the lawyer well.
The lawyer was presented well by the facts of the case.

solution:
The correct answer is **option 2 i.e. The facts of the case had been presented well by the lawyer.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In **active** voice, a sentence emphasizes the subject, performing an action.
 
• In **passive**** voice, **a sentence emphasizes the action or the object of the sentence.
 
• The given sentence is in **Active voice **and it is in **past perfect tense.**
 
• **Active Format:**
 
 
• **​Subject + had + 3rd form of verb + Object **
 
 
 
• **​Passive format:**
 
 
• **Object + had + been + 3rd form of verb + by + subject**
 
 
 
• Hence the correct answer is **option 2.**

 

**​**The correct sentence is: **The facts of the case had been presented well by the lawyer.**
